name: Mogoshyn
description: Mogoshyn was a run-down industrial world located in the Mogoshyn system, a part of the Gordian Reach sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The world lay between the Betshish and Kushibah systems on the Pinooran Spur hyperlane.
lead_paragraphs: Mogoshyn was a run-down industrial world located in the Mogoshyn system, a part of the Gordian Reach sector in the Trans-Hydian portion of the Outer Rim Territories. The world lay between the Betshish and Kushibah systems on the Pinooran Spur hyperlane.
